name: jev-router
description: Routes each Claude Code turn to Haiku, Opus or Fable using TypeSafe's Jev, asks you when Jev is unsure, sends all image work to OpenAI GPT-Image-2.5, and offers security work to OpenAI Daybreak.

haikuModel.title: Haiku model id
haikuModel.description: Model id used for the haiku route (and to drive image tools).

opusModel.title: Opus model id
opusModel.description: Model id used for the opus route and as the fallback.

fableModel.title: Fable model id
fableModel.description: Model id used for the fable route.

confidenceThreshold.title: Ask below this confidence
confidenceThreshold.description: When Jev's confidence in its top route is below this (0 to 1), you are asked to pick the model.

confirmFable.title: Confirm before using Fable
confirmFable.description: Ask before any turn runs on Fable, the most expensive route.

routeSubagents.title: Route subagents
routeSubagents.description: Subagents that don't name a model run on the turn's routed model.

imageDir.title: Image output folder
imageDir.description: Where generated and edited images are saved, relative to the project.

imageBackend.title: Image backend
imageBackend.description: codex: generate through the Codex CLI on your ChatGPT plan (sign in with `codex login`). api: the OpenAI Images API, billed to OPENAI_API_KEY.

codexPath.title: Codex location
codexPath.description: Leave empty to find Codex automatically. Otherwise the path to codex.js (Windows) or the codex executable.

daybreakProgram.title: Daybreak access program
daybreakProgram.description: Cyber access program Codex requests for approved security work (--cyber-access-program). Your OpenAI account decides whether it is granted.

daybreakModel.title: Daybreak model
daybreakModel.description: Leave empty for Codex's default model. Otherwise the OpenAI model id security work runs on.

logPath.title: Decision log
logPath.description: JSONL file recording every routing decision, override and turn usage.
